skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; the one ledger correction this reading supports is proposed through the intake note rather than edited.
A patient genotype-phenotype report supplies no therapeutic lever for the reference genotype class; forging hypotheses from one case would manufacture a lead.
No compound is tested as an intervention with a measured outcome beyond clinical anecdote, so there is no molecule to send to BLOCK-1 triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate for a later BATCH_COMMIT.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader of a paper cannot audit their own locators.

a causal attribution of the observed clinical features to the identified variants cannot be established
